'''Nayva Isoder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. She was a member of [[Rike's Raiders]], a unit led by a strong Republic loyalist General [[Amos Rike]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]], Rike led his loyalists including Major Isoder to displace the Alliance forces on [[Denova]] and seize control of the Denovan [[Baradium Mine]]s. Alliance Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]] send a strike team to Denova to reclaim control of the mines. In the ensuing [[Assault on Denova|battle]], Isoder ambushed the Alliance forces, but was overwhelmed and eventually killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Nayva Isoder appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Trench Runner" Uprising.
